about: A daily all-day series, one day deleted and the delete undone, the series made timed at 16:00 Los Angeles (00:00 UTC the next day) for all events, then the redo of the delete: the same day is skipped again, on its own date (x-undo-fields). On the tree with the R1 fix the redo lands on the equal key, which west of UTC is the day before: that day is given a record and the deleted day stays.
